about.title: Discover Ibiza Harbour
about.description: Ibiza Harbour, also known as Port d'Eivissa or Ibiza Port, is the main waterfront hub of Ibiza Town. It connects marinas, ferry departures, cruise access and the walk up to Dalt Vila, making it the most practical base for first-time visitors who want harbour views, transport links and old-town atmosphere in one place.

disclaimer.title: About This Site
disclaimer.content: This website is an independent travel information guide. We compile practical visitor information from public sources, including official port materials, local tourism references and baseline location data from Google Maps.

highlights.title: Why travellers use this area
items: Main harbour area for walking, photos and waterfront dining
Direct access to Dalt Vila viewpoints and the old town gates
Departure point for Formentera ferries and many boat trips
Separate marina, ferry and cruise areas within the wider port zone
Easy taxi connection from Ibiza Airport and central Ibiza Town
Busy summer evenings with the best atmosphere around sunset

explore.title: Plan Your Visit Around The Harbour

items.title: Harbour Promenade & Marina Views
items.description: The main promenade is the easiest place to get your bearings. You can walk along the waterfront, look across to Dalt Vila and see how the harbour opens into several marina areas rather than a single dock.

items.title: Dalt Vila From The Port
items.description: One of the best reasons to start here is the immediate connection to Ibiza's historic core. From the harbour you can walk toward Portal de ses Taules and climb into Dalt Vila for panoramic views over the port and old town walls.

items.title: Ferries To Formentera
items.description: Port d'Eivissa is the key departure area for Formentera connections. If you are planning a day trip, arrive with time to orient yourself, confirm the operator and follow signage for the correct ferry boarding area.

items.title: Cruise Access & Nearby Services
items.description: The wider port zone also serves cruise visitors, marina guests and local transport. Restaurants, taxis and walking routes are close by, but parking becomes limited quickly in peak season and on summer evenings.

reviews.title: Google Maps Rating & Visitor Notes
reviews.declaration: We no longer reproduce individual visitor quotes on this page. Instead, we show the latest public Google Maps rating together with practical notes that help you plan a visit to Ibiza Harbour.
reviews.notesTitle: What people usually come here for
notes: Waterfront walks with open views of Dalt Vila, marina berths and evening light over the harbour.
Formentera ferry departures, boat excursions and quick orientation when arriving in Ibiza Town.
Restaurants, bars and old-town access within walking distance of the main harbour frontage.
Summer evenings are the busiest period, so parking is limited and taxis or buses are often easier.

address.label: Address
address.value: Avinguda de Santa Eulària des Riu, 17, 07800 Eivissa, Illes Balears, Spain

hours.label: Opening Hours
hours.value: Open 24 hours — Public access area. Commercial venues and restaurants typically open from morning until late night.

transport.label: Getting There
transport.value: From Ibiza Airport (IBZ): ~10-15 min by taxi (~€17) or ~30 min by public bus.

parking.label: Parking
parking.value: Free and paid parking available. Very limited in peak season (June–September) — public transport or taxi recommended.

accessibility.label: Accessibility
accessibility.value: Public waterfront areas are generally walkable, with wheelchair-accessible access points and nearby parking options.
